bosses.name: Azuregos
bosses.general: Blue dragon in Azshara: Mark of Frost, Frost Breath in front, Mana Storm, and he teleports everyone near to him (threat reset).
bosses.tank: Face him away; take him back after each teleport.
bosses.dps: Stop after his teleport until the tank has him again.

bosses.name: Emeriss
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Noxious Breath in front, tail sweep behind, sleeping fog, players who die grow mushrooms.

bosses.name: Lethon
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Shadow Bolt Whirl, shades from every player heal him.
bosses.dps: Kill the shades before they reach him.

bosses.name: Taerar
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Arcane Blast, a fear, and he splits into three shades.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward; tanks for the shades.
bosses.dps: Kill the shades when he splits.

bosses.name: Ysondre
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Lightning Wave chains, calls Demented Druid Spirits.
bosses.tank: Face her away; pick up the spirits.
